newsitem.title: USA: Medical Dynamics gets $6.7 mln camera order.
newsitem.headline: Medical Dynamics gets $6.7 mln camera order.

text.p: Surgical camera systems provider Medical Dynamics Inc said on Tuesday it received an order valued at around $6.7 million from High Tech Medical Instrumentation Inc for 2,000 dental camera systems.
The systems were to be delivered before December 1997 and were part of Medical's existing OEM agreement with High Tech Medical, the company said in a statement.
Initial deliveries were set to begin in the fourth quarter of calendar 1996, it said.
Medical Dynamics said it had been working with High Tech Medical for several months to develop this new dental intraoral camera.

"HTMI's purchase order combined with our new True Vision intraoral dental camera and our other OEM intraoral dental cameras gives us a rapidly growing base of business for our dental division," President and Chief Executive Officer Van Horsley said in a statement.
Medical Dynamics said it planned to introduce its new True Vision camera to selected domestic and international dealers later this month.
